title: Chile Sends Mixed Signals on Private Capital in Codelco
summary: Chilean authorities sent mixed messages on the future of copper giant Codelco as the finance minister opened the door to private capital while the company’s chairman said it had no plans to go public.

title: Yen Surges as Nikkei Says Japan Intervened in Market Again
summary: The yen soared by the most in more than two years against the US dollar, with Japan’s Nikkei newspaper reporting that officials stepped in once again to try and prop up the nation’s sagging currency.

title: Chip Stocks Post Biggest Advance Since April 2025: Markets Wrap
summary: A rebound in giant chipmakers lifted stocks as dip buyers emerged on speculation that the artificial-intelligence trade that has powered the bull market has more room to run.

title: Carvana Bears Reap $500 Million as Stock Sinks on Profit Miss
summary: The slump in the shares of online used-car dealer Carvana Co. on Thursday is creating a potential windfall for investors who have been bearish on the stock.

title: Churchill Downs Shares Fall on Plans to Sell Casinos, Keep Derby
summary: Churchill Downs Inc. shares tumbled nearly 7% on Thursday to their lowest level in six years after the company announced plans to sell nine of its regional casinos and focus on its horseracing properties.

title: Aon Keeps Margin Edge as Industry Tailwinds Fade
summary: Aon CEO Edmund Reese said that despite rising geopolitical risk, customers want to understand how to protect their assets as they continue to grow and invest. Reese said that his company has been investing in tools and data to help the client base better understand their exposure as risk factors intermingle for the business community.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Gold Advances as Traders Weigh Fed Rate Path After Latest Hold
summary: Gold edged higher as traders weighed the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate path following its latest decision to leave rates unchanged.

title: Strategy Shores Up Liquidity as Faithful Wait on Rebound
summary: After roiling crypto markets with a sweeping overhaul of the financing model underpinning Strategy Inc.’s Bitcoin buying blueprint, Michael Saylor has investors wondering what’s next while reporting another multibillion loss tied to the declining value of the cryptocurrency accumulator’s holdings.

title: Swarthmore Loses AAA Rating From S&P Over Debtload
summary: Swarthmore College, an elite liberal arts school in Pennsylvania, lost its AAA grade from S&P Global Ratings after running up its debts to finance renovations to dormitories, classrooms and other projects across its campus. Bloomberg's Amanda Albright reports on "Bloomberg Real Yield." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Unveils $20 Billion Plan for Washington Dulles Revamp
summary: President Donald Trump announced a plan to overhaul and expand Washington Dulles International Airport near the nation’s capital, his latest makeover project for the region, calling it a “long-overdue renovation and reconstruction.” Bloomberg's Aashna Shah reports on "Bloomberg Real Yield." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Jersey Mike’s Sinks in Trading Debut After $1 Billion IPO
summary: Jersey Mike’s Subs Inc. shares slumped 6% in their first ever trading day, after the company and some of its shareholders raised $1 billion in a US initial public offering that priced at the midpoint of its marketed range.

title: Fitch’s Private Credit Default Rate Hit Record in Second Quarter
summary: The default rate across 1,300 US private debt borrowers tracked by Fitch Ratings rose to a record high in the second quarter, according to a report released Thursday.

title: Microsoft’s $450 Billion Jump Is Biggest in Stock Market History
summary: Microsoft Corp. made market history on Thursday, adding nearly half a trillion dollars to its value, the most by any stock in a single day.

title: Womenswear Firm Reformation Closes Flat After $210.9 Million IPO
summary: Reformation Inc., a sustainable womenswear brand backed by private equity firm Permira, closed barely changed in its trading debut Thursday, after the company raised $210.9 million in a listing that priced at the bottom of its marketed range.

title: Weak Yen Offers Toyota an Earnings Respite From Tariffs, War
summary: The yen’s slide to a 40-year low may be causing headaches for Japanese policymakers, but exporters such as Toyota Motor Corp. are set to reap an earnings boon, offering a much-needed respite from US tariffs, surging oil prices and strained supply chains.
